title: PAH OpenClaw Plugin Manifest
description: Frozen v1 contract for the OpenClaw plugin manifest descriptor. The host loads this file when wiring the OpenClaw adapter into a runtime; the descriptor pins the renderer version + snapshot/profile the plugin was built against so a host can refuse to load a stale plugin against a newer snapshot.

kind.description: Plugin kind. The S9 surface only ships the 'openclaw' kind.

snapshotId.description: Snapshot the plugin was generated against.

profileId.description: Profile the plugin was generated against.

rendererVersion.description: Renderer version the plugin was generated against. A renderer bump forces a plugin re-build.

stateDir.description: Absolute state dir the plugin was built against.

entry.description: JS entry point the host spawns.

requiredCapabilities.description: Capabilities the host must grant before any command runs.
